Name: Pelican Town AI
Author: BadBoy17G
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#8b6914]Pelican Town AI[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/4Q4ZmM2/Screenshot-20260528-024613.png[/img][/center]

[center][i]Talk to villagers with a local LLM. They remember you, gossip about you, score every line you say — and even hand you items.[/i][/center]

[center][/center]

[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ What it is[/color][/size]
[line]

Stand next to any villager in Pelican Town, press [b]C[/b], and start a real conversation. A local language model writes their reply in character — informed by their schedule, your heart level, their daily mood, their canon relationships, and anything they've recently witnessed or heard about you.

Every line you say is scored. Be kind → friendship goes up. Be a jerk → it goes down. The town remembers.

[size=4][color=#6b4423]No cloud, no subscription, no telemetry[/color][/size] — runs entirely on [url=https://ollama.com]Ollama[/url] or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint on your own machine.

[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ Highlights[/color][/size]
[line]

[list]
[*][b]Talk to anyone[/b] — 35+ vanilla villagers + bundled persona pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].[/*]
[*][b]4 tone-varied options + free typing[/b] — Friendly, Hostile, Neutral, Wildcard, or type your own.[/*]
[*][b]Real friendship impact[/b] — the model judges every line (+12 / -5) and applies it to actual heart points. Daily cap (±60) prevents grinding.[/*]
[*][b]Villagers have a daily life[/b] — they know their schedule. Ask "where are you headed?" — they'll tell you.[/*]
[*][b]Per-NPC daily intent[/b] — Lewis privately wants nobody to notice he's nervous; Abigail wants to skip work and ride to the woods.[/*]
[*][b]Witnessing[/b] — chat near another villager? They overhear. Mention it later, they remember.[/*]
[*][b]Gossip propagation[/b] — Caroline (gossipiness 9) actually leaks; Linus (1) keeps secrets. Information mutates as it spreads.[/*]
[*][b]Tool calls[/b] — NPCs can [b]give_item[/b] (Pierre = seeds, Marnie = eggs/milk, Willy = fish, Linus = forage…), [b]start_quest[/b], or [b]follow_player[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Long-term memory[/b] — older chat history auto-summarizes into a "what they remember about you" line.[/*]
[*][b]Live streaming[/b] — replies appear word-by-word as the model generates them.[/*]
[*][b]Emotion portraits[/b] — face swaps to happy / sad / intense based on what you just said.[/*]
[*][b]Bonus[/b]: optional paraphraser that rewrites vanilla dialogue lines through the LLM for variety.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ Quick start[/color][/size]
[line]

[size=4][b]1. Install Ollama and pull a model[/b][/size]

[code]
# https://ollama.com
ollama serve                      # listens on localhost:11434
ollama pull qwen3.5:4b            # ~3.4 GB, fits any modern GPU[/code]
For best results use a 3B+ instruction-tuned model. Confirmed good picks: [b]qwen3.5:4b[/b], [b]llama3.2:3b[/b], [b]qwen2.5:7b-instruct[/b], [b]phi3:mini[/b].

[size=4][b]2. Install the mod[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Make sure SMAPI 4.0+ is installed[/*]
[*]Extract this archive into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b][/*]
[*]Launch the game[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]3. Configure from inside the game[/b][/size]

Open Generic Mod Config Menu → Pelican Town AI:

[list]
[*][b]Backend preset[/b] (Ollama / llama.cpp / OpenAI / Custom) — auto-fills the URL[/*]
[*][b]Quick-pick model[/b] — popular models in a dropdown[/*]
[*][b]Test connection[/b] button — pings the endpoint and lists every model available there[/*]
[*][b]Send 'Hello' test[/b] button — runs a real completion to verify the model works[/*]
[/list]
No config-file editing required.

[size=4][b]4. Talk to someone[/b][/size]

Load your save, walk up to a villager, press [b]C[/b]. Pick 1-4 (or type your own with 5/T). Watch the reply stream in.

[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ What does the model actually see?[/color][/size]
[line]

When you chat with Lewis, the LLM gets — in one prompt — everything below:

[code]
You are roleplaying as Lewis from Stardew Valley.
Persona: Mayor of Pelican Town, late 50s. Official, proud of the town,
  hosts the festivals. Secretly seeing Marnie and very anxious that nobody
  find out. Pompous in public, sheepish in private.
Game state: Player: Praveen (male). Relationship: friendly acquaintance
  (3/14 hearts). It is Fri the 12th of summer, 14:20, weather clear.
NPC's current life: Right now you are at the town square. Since 09:00 you've
  been at the town square to walk around. At 14:00 you'll head to your manor.
NPC's social ties:
  Secret romance (the town does NOT know): Marnie (4h with player)
  Tensions: slight rivalry with Pierre over town leadership
  You belong to: elders, authority
  Gossipiness: 4/10
  Private knowledge only you have: You are secretly seeing Marnie and very
    anxious nobody finds out. Your lucky purple shorts live at her house.
What Lewis wants today: I just hope nobody notices how nervous I am while
  trying to plan the festival.
Recent gossip you heard about the farmer:
  - today, Marnie told you: "The farmer mentioned the purple shorts again"
    (may have been distorted as it passed around)

[and a list of items Lewis could realistically give the player,
his generosity rating, friendship-cap budget for today, and the
strict reply/tool consistency rules][/code]
Then it generates a reply, scores how your line landed, picks an emotion, optionally invokes a tool, and proposes your next four response options — all in one round trip.

[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ Performance[/color][/size]
[line]

Measured on an RTX 4090 with Ollama + qwen3.5:4b:

[list]
[*][b]Per turn[/b] (reply + score + tools + next options): 300-900 ms[/*]
[*][b]First streamed token[/b]: ~250 ms[/*]
[*][b]Initial menu open[/b]: ~1.5 s[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla-dialogue paraphrase[/b]: < 5 ms cached, 150-400 ms fresh[/*]
[/list]
VRAM ~3.5 GB for qwen3.5:4b. The game continues running smoothly while the LLM thinks (calls are async on a background thread).

[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ FAQ[/color][/size]
[line]

[b]Does this require internet?[/b]
No, if you use Ollama or llama.cpp. Both run entirely on your machine and the mod never makes outbound requests anywhere else. (If you point it at a cloud OpenAI-compatible API, your conversations obviously go there.)

[b]Will it slow my game?[/b]
No. All LLM calls happen on a background thread. The game keeps running while the model thinks.

[b]Can other NPCs see what I say?[/b]
Yes — that's the witnessing system. If a villager is within ~3 tiles when you chat with someone else, they overhear. The next time you chat with them, they may reference what they heard.

[b]Will the model just give me free items if I ask?[/b]
Sometimes. Each NPC has a curated inventory (Pierre = seeds, Marnie = eggs/milk, Willy = fish) and a generosity rating (Linus = 9, Pierre = 2). Asking politely with high hearts → likely yes. Demanding rare items from a stranger → no. The model judges in character. You won't get a diamond from the Wizard by demanding one.

[b]Can I be a jerk?[/b]
Absolutely. The "Hostile" option is intentional. Each rude line costs friendship — and gets remembered.

[b]Does friendship really change?[/b]
Yes, real heart points. Daily cap of +60 / -50 per NPC per day prevents grinding. The header in the chat menu shows your remaining budget.

[b]What about modded NPCs (SVE, Ridgeside, custom)?[/b]
SVE is auto-detected and a bundled persona pack loads. Other modded NPCs fall back to a generic "friendly Pelican Town villager" persona but otherwise work. Other mods can also call the API to register custom personas for their NPCs.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]
Currently single-player only. The LLM calls happen per-player; nothing's synced.

[b]Can I customize personas?[/b]
Yes — either edit Personas.cs (recompile) or use the public API from another mod: [b]api.SetPersona("Abigail", "..."));[/b]

[b]What models do you recommend?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]qwen3.5:4b[/b] (default) — sweet spot of quality vs speed on a single GPU[/*]
[*][b]llama3.2:3b[/b] — faster, slightly less expressive[/*]
[*][b]qwen2.5:7b-instruct[/b] — better quality, needs ~6 GB VRAM[/*]
[*][b]gpt-4o-mini[/b] (cloud) — if you don't mind sending your chats to OpenAI, this is the highest-quality option[/*]
[/list]
[b]I get empty replies from a reasoning model (Qwen3-thinking, DeepSeek-R1).[/b]
The OpenAI-compat layer doesn't suppress the model's hidden reasoning, so all tokens go to thinking and content comes back empty. Fix: in the config, set [b]ApiUrl[/b] to [b]http://localhost:11434/api/chat[/b] (Ollama native). The mod sends [b]think:false[/b] automatically.

[b]Mod won't load — "Couldn't find DialogueBox.dialogues" warning[/b]
That just disables the bonus paraphraser feature, not the chat. Probably means the Stardew version is newer than what was tested. Chat still works fine.

[b]Why isn't the NPC actually handing me the item it said it would?[/b]
[list]
[*]Check [b]ToolsEnabled: true[/b] in config.[/*]
[*]The item must be in the NPC's curated inventory list. Off-list requests get refused. Try asking for something they'd realistically have.[/*]
[*]To experiment with broader scope, set [b]ToolsStrictScope: false[/b] (not recommended — it lets NPCs invent items).[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][color=#6b4423]✦ For mod authors — public API[/color][/size]
[line]

Drive the LLM stack from your own mod:

[code]
var api = Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IDialogueParaphraserApi>("badboysm890.PelicanTownAI");

// Health check
bool ok = await api.IsHealthyAsync();

// Generate opening suggestions for an NPC
List<string> options = await api.SuggestOpeningOptionsAsync("Abigail");

// Send a player line, get back a structured turn result
TurnPublicResult turn = await api.SendPlayerLineAsync("Abigail",
    "Want to explore the mines tonight?");
// → turn.Reply, turn.Delta, turn.Reason, turn.Emotion,
//  turn.NextOptions, turn.ToolEffects

// Drive the LLM directly with a custom prompt
string raw = await api.RawCompleteAsync(
    systemPrompt: "You are a helpful smith.",
    userPrompt: "What's a good first weapon?");

// Override the persona for an NPC (yours or vanilla)
api.SetPersona("Abigail", "Modded persona text here...");[/code]
See [b]docs/MOD_INTEGRATION.md[/b] in the source repo for the full API reference.
